release_notes: Integrations, reviewed end to end. The Back Button Trap works: the Integrations page shipped a stale copy that never fired; it now uses the campaign editor's generator, is armed by the visitor's first click or tap (browsers ignore traps set earlier), and counts each return once as a click tagged sub1=back_button. Geo Redirect, WordPress, Static site and App Config work for real visitors: their public endpoints (detect_geo, app_config) sat behind the panel login and answered 401 to everyone else. Every code card now fills itself in: pick a campaign (or an App Config) and the token, id and the campaign's https domain go into the code — no CAMPAIGN_TOKEN / YOUR_ID / CONFIG_KEY to edit by hand and no bare http://IP that https landings refuse; the card warns when the panel itself is open over http or an IP. Every card now says what it does and where it goes — your own site, a landing on your hosting or a landing uploaded to Orbitra — with subtitles and statuses translated into all seven languages, and the code editor there is readable again.
